merge_policy: Source priority with explicit identities or unique exact names. Try later feeds when earlier listings are stale, placeholders, invalid, or overlapping. One source per channel.
timezone_policy: Parse explicit UTC offsets; preserve instants; player guide offset 0.
verification_scope: Timestamp integrity and identity rules checked. Regional feeds and every broadcast are not independently confirmed. Total name matches and usable current schedules are separate counts.
genre_policy: Preserve non-empty programme categories. When missing, add the channel category mapped to an Android TV genre. General/unknown channels remain unclassified; never create programmes to supply a genre.

additional_entries.policy: Use independent playlist IDs. Exact stream duplicates may reuse primary schedules; reviewed aliases use only their approved regional sources. Unidentified/custom stations receive no guessed guide.

primary_source_entries.policy: Require an enabled catalog ID actually present in the DRM playlist. No inheritance from parent name or stream index. Unique exact URL duplicates may reuse the matching primary guide; other station variants require reviewed ID/name-bound regional mappings.
